images.name: cover
images.title: An *AI Data Entry clerk* checks before it saves
images.sub: Invoices, forms and orders into your systems: what it enters, what it checks, and what still goes to a person.

images.name: steps
images.title: The data entry job, *step by step*
rows: Watches the inboxes, scanner folders and upload forms, and pulls every new document into one queue.
Pulls supplier, dates, line items and totals, or names and details from forms. Marks any field it isn't sure of.
Matches invoices to the PO and delivery note, catches duplicates, recalculates totals and checks required fields.
Enters passed records into the right system and files the original with a link back to it.
Anything that fails a check, can't be read or changes bank details goes to a person with the document.

images.name: day-on-shift
images.title: A day at a *wholesale distributor*
rows: Reads 14 overnight supplier invoices. Matches 12 to purchase orders and delivery notes and enters them.
One invoice number was already paid in September. Held as a duplicate and logged.
A unit price is 6% higher than the purchase order. Held with both documents attached.
Enters three faxed packing lists into the inventory sheet and updates stock counts.
A supplier invoice lists new bank details. Held for a phone check with a known contact.
Files the day's PDFs by supplier and month, each linked to its accounting entry.
Sends the daily summary: 15 entered, 1 duplicate stopped, 2 waiting on a person.

images.name: setup
images.title: Setting up an *AI Data Entry clerk*
steps: Last month's documents, including the faxed, crooked and oddly formatted ones.
What each entry is compared to, which fields are required, and what always goes to a person.
Inboxes, scanner folders and the software it enters into, with only the access the job needs.
Compare every field it pulls to what a person entered, before it touches a live system.
It prepares entries and a person approves them. Each document type goes live on its own.
Someone reads the exception list and updates the rules when a supplier or form changes.
